# NBN Design

> NBN Design is an independent Australian consultancy that prepares NBN pit and pipe designs for single dwelling unit (SDU) and multi dwelling unit (MDU) developments, Australia-wide. Designs are prepared by Michael Almond, an NBN accredited designer (enAble ID 439386). Pricing is per unit and falls as a project grows: $120 per unit for 1 to 10 units, $108 for 11 to 25, $95 for 26 to 50, $82 for 51 to 100 and $70 from 101 units. Plans are turned around within two weeks of receiving complete CAD plans. NBN Design is not affiliated with or endorsed by NBN Co Limited.

## Services
- [SDU design](https://nbndesign.net/sdu-pit-and-pipe-design): NBN pit and pipe design for subdivisions, duplexes and triplexes: one P20 per premises, 25 m service drop limit, pit placement rules. From $120 per lot.
- [MDU design](https://nbndesign.net/mdu-pit-and-pipe-design): NBN pit and pipe design for apartments, townhouses and super lots: P50/P100 lead-ins, comms room and riser space, pathways to each unit. From $120 per dwelling.
- [Pricing](https://nbndesign.net/pricing): NBN pit and pipe design from $120 per unit, with lower rates as your project grows. Use the calculator for an estimate.

## Guides
- [How the NBN new developments process works](https://nbndesign.net/nbn-pit-and-pipe-process): Every step from design to NBN's Certificate of Practical Completion, and where projects lose time.
- [NBN for a duplex or small subdivision: what to sort before design](https://nbndesign.net/nbn-duplex-small-subdivision-checklist): Eight things to sort before NBN design on a duplex, triplex or subdivision of up to about 20 lots.
- [SDU or MDU: which NBN design does your development need?](https://nbndesign.net/sdu-or-mdu-nbn-design): Subdivisions, duplexes, townhouses, super lots and apartments, and the rules for each.
- [NBN pits and conduit: a plain guide for developers](https://nbndesign.net/nbn-pit-and-conduit-basics): Pit types, conduit sizes, NBN's pit capacity table, clearances, bends and depth of cover.
- [How to prepare CAD plans for NBN pit and pipe design](https://nbndesign.net/preparing-cad-plans-for-nbn-design): A checklist for your DWG plans, and the missing details that slow jobs down.
- [What's in an NBN pit and pipe design package](https://nbndesign.net/pit-and-pipe-design-package): The drawings and files you receive, what you upload to NBN, revisions, and exclusions.
- [How long does NBN pit and pipe design take?](https://nbndesign.net/nbn-design-timelines): Our two-week turnaround, what affects it, and NBN's stages after design.
